title: MEMENTO：面向长上下文处理智能体的上下文管理学习
summary: MEMENTO 基于 Qwen3-8B 训练智能体学习上下文压缩管理：先用带事后标注笔记的合成轨迹微调，再用结合答案正确性、笔记质量与置信度校准的强化学习优化。在最长 250 万 token 的书籍级问答上，准确率从 36.9% 提升至 67.8%，上下文始终不超过 20K token，成本远低于 GPT-5.5 和 GLM-5.3。
summary_en: MEMENTO trains a Qwen3-8B long-context agent to manage its context via compaction: bootstrapped with hindsight-annotated synthetic notes, then reinforced with RL rewarding answer correctness, note quality, and confidence calibration. On book-level QA up to 2.5M tokens, it lifts accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8% while never exceeding 20K tokens of context, beating GPT-5.5 agents and full-context baselines at a fraction of the cost.
